expected_symptom: cmake --install / ninja install deposits LLVM and Clang headers, static archives and developer tools under the prefix rather than only the dxc executable, DXC headers and DXC libraries.
godbolt_skip: Compiler Explorer compiles a single HLSL source; it cannot configure a CMake build or run an install target, and this issue has no shader repro. The evidence is the install rules and a measured install tree instead.
reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet independent review (batch-012 step-10; blind 3414)
summary: Default install target still deposits LLVM/Clang headers, archives and dev tools; since v1.7.2308 an install-distribution target yields exactly the six DXC files the reporter asked for, and -DLLVM_INSTALL_TOOLCHAIN_ONLY=ON removes most of the rest, but neither is documented.
title: Install target installs lots of unnecessary LLVM outputs
